title: Synthesis, crystal structural description, DNA binding, molecular docking, and anticancer evaluation of the novel platinum(IV) supramolecular complex.
authors: Domyati, Doaa; Ali, Ehab M M; Hussien, Mostafa A; Davaasuren, Bambar; Jaremko, Mariusz; El-Bendary, Mohamed M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究铂(IV)超分子复合物的合成、晶体结构及其与DNA的沟槽结合和分子对接，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作建模，但对象为小分子-核酸体系而非TF-DNA，方法以实验为主、对接为辅，可借鉴其DNA结合机制与对接流程。
abstract: A novel platinum(IV) supramolecular complex; [PtCl(2)(2,2'-bipy)(2)](PtCl(6)) was synthesized in aqueous acetonitrile solution at ambient temperature with constant stirring. The structure was confirmed by elemental analysis, FT-IR, UV-vis, NMR spectroscopy, and single-crystal X-ray diffraction, revealing a unique distorted octahedral geometry and a three-dimensional network stabilized by hydrogen bonding and pi-pi stacking. DNA binding studies, including electronic absorption titration and viscometry, indicated a groove binding mechanism with a binding constant (K(b)) of 5.00 x 10(6) M(-1). Molecular docking with DNA (PDB ID: 1BNA) and cancer-related proteins (PDB codes: 3ig7, 3eqm, 4fm9) supports these interactions, while in vitro anticancer assays demonstrated potent cytotoxicity with IC(5)(0) values of 41.37 muM for HepG2, 47.62 muM for HCT116, and 73.90 muM for MDA-MB-231 cells, outperforming cisplatin in selectivity. This study not only advances our understanding of structure-activity relationships in platinum-based complexes but also highlights the potential of this complex as a promising candidate for developing more effective and less toxic anticancer agents.
abstract_zh: 一种新型铂(IV)超分子配合物[PtCl(2)(2,2'-联吡啶)(2)](PtCl(6))在室温下于含水乙腈溶液中持续搅拌合成。通过元素分析、FT-IR、UV-vis、NMR光谱及单晶X射线衍射确认了其结构，揭示了一种独特的扭曲八面体几何构型及由氢键和π-π堆积稳定的三维网络。DNA结合研究，包括电子吸收滴定和粘度测定，表明其具有沟槽结合机制，结合常数(K(b))为5.00 x 10(6) M(-1)。与DNA（PDB ID: 1BNA）及癌症相关蛋白（PDB代码：3ig7、3eqm、4fm9）的分子对接支持这些相互作用，而体外抗癌实验显示其具有强效细胞毒性，对HepG2、HCT116和MDA-MB-231细胞的IC(5)(0)值分别为41.37 μM、47.62 μM和73.90 μM，在选择性上优于顺铂。本研究不仅增进了我们对铂基配合物构效关系的理解，还强调了该配合物作为开发更有效且毒性更低的抗癌药物的有前景候选物的潜力。
